summary: Agent guidance: name new database migrations with UTC timestamp + slug (e.g. 20261109T111800Z_residue_baseline.sql); use sequential numbers only when the migration tool requires it.
migration_impact: Adopters receive the new on-demand page via import-payload or self-migrate. No renames of existing migrations; no CI enforcement.
agent_notes: Before adding a schema migration, load docs/agents/database-migration-naming.md. Default to YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ_short_slug.ext at creation time. Keep sequential numbering only when the toolchain forces it and document that exception in the repo. Never rename existing migration files.
migration_guidance: 1. Refresh AGENTS.md and docs/agents/ from PLATE import-payload or self-migrate when convenient.
2. Teach agents (and humans) the timestamp slug convention for all new migrations.
3. If your migration tool requires numeric ordering, state that in README, SPEC.md, or docs/migration/ instead of silently using sequential names.
